predecessors.name: Emishi
predecessors.text: the six Emishi districts of the Kitakami Basin 'from Morioka to Hiraizumi' and the Emishi domains around them, 'Mutsu province, Tohoku region'

successors.name: Heian Japan
successors.text: the Abe lands after the 'Imperial victory' at Kuriyagawa in 1062, held by the court's governors with the Kiyohara of Dewa

ledger.x: 1051: Abe no Yoritoki defies the court.

1051: Yoritoki 'led Emishi forces into northern Miyagi and defeated a government army at Onikiribe', which 'triggered the Former Nine Years' War'; Minamoto no Yoriyoshi was sent against him in 1053 as Chinjufu Shogun.

wars.name: Former Nine Years' War
wars.outcome: Imperial victory: Abe no Sadato surrendered at Kuriyagawa in 1062; the Abe lands passed to the court's governors.

certainty.note: Only fortresses (Koromo, Kuriyagawa, Isawa, Kurosawa) are named; no boundary is given.
